kind: Draft schema author checks; no live renderer or owner mapping acceptance

checks.name: Schema is valid for its declared dialect
A personal task cannot be approved
A receipt cannot carry decision choices
Approved decision requires a ruling object
Deferred decision requires a ruling object
Requesting changes is distinct from approval
Unknown historical snapshot and time are representable
Exact snapshot cannot omit answered revision
Exact snapshot cannot omit proposal source references
Missing choices need an explicit withholding reason
Unknown fields are rejected, not silently discarded
Invalid calendar date is rejected with format checking
Production mode is outside this draft dialect
Choosing a recommendation requires an option ID
Long original ruling text has no schema truncation cap
Ruling must explicitly represent its conditions
Fictional example IDs, references and local source resolve

limitations: Real WQ mappings remain PROME work.
No queue renderer, app reader or response intake implemented.
Schema shape does not authenticate a ruling or prove source truth.
General semantic/reference/path-boundary validation remains an acceptance requirement.
